title: Depth bound for pairwise XOR construction
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every finite list of pairs of circuits on $n$ variables, applying the pairwise XOR construction yields a list whose pair depth is at most two plus the original list's pair depth.
hypotheses_covered: the input is a finite list of pairs of circuits on $n$ variables
